interpretation_limits: On/off fixes KL direction and the selected recipe, but also changes length/EOS distribution, first-position weight and the states seen by actual-prefix address CE.
First prediction prefixes match before any token is sampled. One/two-token answers leave little room for long-range on-policy benefits.
All arms include supervised canonical replay and fact-identity address losses; this is not pure distillation or fully unsupervised online learning.
Only half of4096 offline facts are main targets in256x8 updates; remaining facts can occur in72-record address/memory episodes.
Teacher100% greedy EM on clean questions does not by itself prove sharp entropy or correctness on wrong sampled prefixes; use answer NLL only for clean-prefix confidence.
Hidden cosine is a final-state geometry diagnostic; higher values do not establish output correctness or pure semantics.
The0.1 hidden weight has no weight sweep/gradient decomposition; failure of this setting is not failure of all hidden distillation.
64 development entities and two new-style families were previously inspected; no blind confirmation or training-seed replication.
Balanced q/s style pairs use16 different facts per cell, not every new style on every fact. Comparisons across methods remain paired by entity.
Prefix-match metric compares exact histories before each prediction; the first position always matches and is therefore reported separately.
Rollout and input token counters count unpadded valid tokens; they are not padded compute/FLOPs measurements.
Single deterministic value shuffle can assign another record with the same answer; use paired real-minus-shuffled effects rather than assuming0% shuffled chance.
